about_the_game:
Get ready for brand-new logistical challenges in the Warehouse DLC! This time, you’ll step into an outdoor warehouse filled with tricky obstacles, fresh mechanics, and plenty of new levels to conquer.

  • A completely new outdoor warehouse environment
  • 30 new levels packed with tricky puzzles and obstacles
  • New blocks that expand gameplay and the level editor – gate, fence, button, conveyor belt
  • New cube visuals

Overcome new challenges and take your skills to the next level! Can you handle the chaos of an industrial warehouse?
